deployments_detail.use: GenAI application (with Microsoft) to read & analyze requirement specs (Lastenhefte) near error-free, identifying key sections and summarizing requirements

AI-Based Requirements Engineering (ReqNet): analyzes automotive specification sheets (up to 30,000 requirements per document), automatically extracting and assigning requirements to development centers. In production across automotive division development departments; won 2025 Microsoft Intelligent Manufacturing Award. [Microsoft Azure AI Services; NTT DATA]
deployments_detail.value: up to 80% less effort for specification analysis (previously ~37,500 hours/project)

deployments_detail.use: First predictive ML model in Continental Tires R&D: forecasts tire performance from manufacturing variables, test results, and historical data, delivering overnight predictions to 100+ tire developers instead of waiting ~2 months for physical test results. Deployed and operational. [Valohai (orchestration); R/Python on AWS, Aurora, S3]
deployments_detail.value: R&D cycle cut from ~2 months (physical test) to overnight predictions for 100+ developers

deployments_detail.use: In-vehicle generative-AI voice assistant integrated into Continental's Smart Cockpit High-Performance Computer, letting drivers/passengers converse naturally with the car (e.g., tire pressure specs, route landmarks, manual lookups). Announced production-ready within 18 months at IAA Mobility 2023. [Google Cloud (Conversational AI)]

AI-based automated and continuous tire tread depth measurement: new-generation tire sensors plus AI algorithms determine tread depth by measuring changes in the tire's radial acceleration, feeding the ContiConnect fleet digital solution.

Aurora Driver: co-developed SAE Level 4 autonomous driving system (AI perception/planning stack) for Class 8 trucks. Design finalized; Continental plans scale production of the fallback-capable hardware/software system in 2027. [Aurora Innovation; NVIDIA]

Industrial Co-Pilot: a generative-AI virtual factory agent letting engineers query production lines in natural language, do root-cause analysis, and get step-by-step maintenance instructions, integrated with a 3D digital twin of the shop floor. [NVIDIA Omniverse / OpenUSD; SoftServe]
deployments_detail.value: 10% expected reduction in maintenance effort and downtime

deployments_detail.use: Agentic AI for supply chain optimization: Continental optimizes its complex supply chain using AWS agentic AI to make planning decisions transparent and actionable, presented at Hannover Messe / AWS re:Invent automotive sessions. [AWS (agentic AI / Bedrock)]

Virtual ECU (vECU) Creator: cloud-based digital-twin platform letting automotive developers configure Electronic Control Units and test/debug embedded software before physical hardware exists, supporting Classic and Adaptive AUTOSAR. Launched product within Continental Automotive Edge. [AWS; Elektrobit (Continental)]
deployments_detail.value: shortens development time by up to 12 months

deployments_detail.use: Automotive coding assistant for embedded software: an AI solution built with AWS that helps automotive developers create, review, and test embedded software, accelerating embedded software development. [AWS]
